title: What If Every Plane Was Grounded for a Year?

scenes.text: What if every plane was grounded for a year? In 2020, the world got a preview.
In 2020, air passenger traffic fell about sixty percent, roughly two point seven billion fewer travellers than the year before.
At the lockdown peak, aviation emissions fell more than half, and in December were still about forty percent lower.
US contrail coverage fell about twenty percent in 2020. Contrails may cause roughly half of aviation's warming.
Cargo felt it too: in April 2020, space in passenger planes on international routes fell about seventy-five percent.
Yet aviation is only about two and a half percent of CO2. The world's total fell seven percent, and CO2 kept rising.

description:
What if every plane was grounded for a year?
2020 gave a preview: passenger traffic fell about 60 percent and global fossil CO2 about 7 percent, yet atmospheric CO2 still rose.
What should we run through next?
first_comment: Would you give up flying for a year? Tell us your own what-if. What should we run through next?
